commit.message: feat(tax): optimize regional tax calculation with new tax engine v2

correlation.summary: Error spike (73.7%) appeared immediately following deployment of revision order-checkout-service-00002-v110 (commit 4f9a2b8) by alex.chen@enterprise.com.

diagnosis.incidentHeadline: Null pointer dereference in tax calculation introduced in commit 4f9a2b8 by alex.chen@enterprise.com
diagnosis.rootCauseHypothesis: Commit 4f9a2b8 introduced a call to 'user.taxProfile.calculateRegional()' without checking if 'user.taxProfile' exists. For guest checkout requests, user.taxProfile is undefined, throwing an unhandled TypeError that crashes checkout transactions with HTTP 500.

primarySuspect.author: alex.chen@enterprise.com
primarySuspect.message: feat(tax): optimize regional tax calculation with new tax engine v2
primarySuspect.bugExplanation: Guest checkouts lack user.taxProfile, causing TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'calculateRegional') at calculateRegionalTax() in taxEngine.js:54.

diagnosis.evidenceCorrelation: Deployment occurred 1m ago. The error rate spiked from baseline (<0.1%) to 73.7% immediately following traffic shift to order-checkout-service-00002-v110.
runbookSteps: Approve immediate 1-click traffic rollback to previous stable revision order-checkout-service-00001-v100 (v1.0.0).
Verify Cloud Monitoring error rate drops back to <0.1% within 60 seconds.
Notify on-call team in Slack channel #incidents-oncall of mitigation status.
Revert commit 4f9a2b8 on main branch and open high-priority fix ticket for alex.chen@enterprise.com.
